network: Provider access is required for native runs. Managed Codex tests also need runtime acquisition. The MCP server is local stdio.
credentials: test_harness.py explicitly maps MY_OPENAI_KEY to the Codex child OPENAI_API_KEY. Other Codex examples may reuse eligible host authentication when no explicit references are selected; do not assume other adapters copy host login files. test_agent_claude.py needs a non-empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or a credential_env mapping to CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN; Claude Code never reuses a host login. Set model variables to identifiers available to the configured account.
